witty.dialogue.chat/1: Well now, there's a face worth stopping for. Talk to me, %1$s.
witty.dialogue.chat/2: You caught me in a good mood, which is most moods. What's on your mind?
witty.dialogue.chat/3: Perfect timing, %1$s — I was just thinking the day needed some company.
witty.dialogue.conversations/1: A proper talk? Gladly. Pull up a spot, %1$s, I've got time and good humour.
witty.dialogue.conversations/2: Oh, I'd like that. There's not much that beats a good conversation, %1$s.
witty.dialogue.conversations/3: Let's talk properly, then. Days go better when somebody asks.
witty.dialogue.conversations.checkin.goo: Really well, thank you for asking! The bread rose, the roof held, and the morning was kind. I'll take it.
Good — genuinely good. Small things went right and I noticed all of them. That's the trick, I think.
Wonderfully. Nothing dramatic, just a week that behaved itself. Those are the best kind.
witty.dialogue.conversations.checkin.rou: Bit of a rough one, honestly. But you asking has already improved it, %1$s. That counts for a lot.
Not my finest week — though it's turning around as we speak. Funny how that works.
witty.dialogue.conversations.checkin.aga: You've asked already, %1$s! Still good. I'd tell you if it changed, I promise.
Twice now — you must really want good news. Happily, I've still got some.
witty.dialogue.conversations.day.good/1: Lovely day. The chickens behaved, the sun showed up, and I got the fence finished. Small victories, stacked up.
witty.dialogue.conversations.day.good/2: A good one! Quiet, warm, everything where I left it. I'll remember this one fondly.
witty.dialogue.conversations.day.rough/1: Bucket broke, fence sagged, and I lost an hour to both. Still — the evening's coming, and evenings are forgiving.
witty.dialogue.conversations.day.rough/2: Everything's been slightly against me today. But tomorrow's fresh, and I quite like tomorrows.
witty.dialogue.conversations.work.like/1: I do, actually! It keeps my hands busy and my head quiet, and at the end there's something that wasn't there before.
witty.dialogue.conversations.work.like/2: Very much. There's a real satisfaction in doing a thing properly, even a small thing. Especially a small thing.
witty.dialogue.conversations.work.hate/1: Some days it wears on me, I'll admit. But it feeds the village, and that's worth a sore back.
witty.dialogue.conversations.work.hate/2: It's not what I'd have picked. Still, I've made peace with it — and peace beats grumbling, most days.
witty.dialogue.conversations.village.hom: %2$s? I'm fond of it. Good people, a decent well, and somebody always waving. That's a fine place to land.
I like %2$s more each year. It's not grand, but it's warm, and warm lasts longer than grand.
witty.dialogue.conversations.people.firs: They're good folk, %1$s. Every one of them has something worth knowing, if you give them the chance to show it.
I like them. Properly. They look out for each other here, and that's not nothing.
witty.dialogue.conversations.food.first/: Fresh bread, still warm, with far too much butter. Simple things done well — that's my whole philosophy, really.
Anything shared at a full table. The food matters less than the company, though the baker's rye helps.
witty.dialogue.conversations.life.first/: My whole story? It's a good one, %1$s — not grand, but good. Plenty of bright spots, and I remember those best.
Ups and downs like anyone's, but I've been lucky more often than not. Sit down and I'll tell you the good parts.
witty.dialogue.conversations.dreams.firs: A full table, a warm house, and people in it who want to be there. I've most of it already, which is rather the point.
Nothing grand. To be someone the village is glad to see coming. I'm working on it daily.
witty.dialogue.conversations.fears.first: That I'd stop noticing the good days. It'd be so easy to let them blur past, %1$s. I'd hate that.
Turning sour. I've seen it happen to good people, and I'd rather not join them.
witty.dialogue.conversations.feelings.fi: Honestly? You brighten the day when you turn up, %1$s. I don't see the point in pretending otherwise.
I'm always glad to see you. That's the plain truth of it, and I'm happy to say it out loud.
witty.dialogue.conversations.deflect.per: Ah — that's a bigger question than we've earned yet, %1$s. Keep visiting, though. I'm not hard to open up.
Not quite yet. Ask me again when we've a few more good afternoons behind us — I'd like that.
witty.dialogue.conversations.deflect.int: That's deep water, %1$s, and I'd want to wade in properly. Give it time. I'm not going anywhere.
You're asking the real questions now. I like that. I'm just not ready to answer that one — yet.
witty.dialogue.conversations.gossip.none: Quiet week, happily! Nothing but good weather and the usual well-side chatter. I'll take a dull week gladly.
No news at all, which is its own good news. Everyone's well, everyone's fed. That'll do.
witty.dialogue.conversations.us.happy.ye: Happy? Every single day, %1$s. I'd say it more often but you'd stop believing me.
Yes. Easily, gladly, and without a moment's doubt. You're the best thing I've said yes to.
witty.dialogue.conversations.gossip.marr: Wonderful news — %2$s and %3$s are married! The whole square turned out. I may have cried a bit.
%2$s and %3$s wed this week. Two happy people and a very good cake. A fine day all round.
witty.dialogue.conversations.gossip.divo: %2$s and %3$s have parted ways. Sad, but they were kind about it — and kindness at the end counts for something.
So %2$s and %3$s are no longer together. A shame. Still, better honest apart than miserable together.
witty.dialogue.conversations.gossip.deat: I'm sorry to carry this one, %1$s — %2$s has passed. They were dearly liked. We'll remember them well, and that matters.
%2$s is gone. I keep thinking of the good they did here. That's what stays, in the end.
witty.dialogue.conversations.gossip.birt: Best news of the week — %2$s was born! Healthy, loud, and thoroughly adored already.
A baby, %1$s! %2$s has arrived and the whole village is soft about it. Myself very much included.
witty.dialogue.conversations.gossip.arri: %2$s has moved in! New neighbours are a gift — a whole person's worth of stories we haven't heard yet.
We've a newcomer: %2$s. I brought them bread on the first day. Seemed the least I could do.
witty.dialogue.conversations.gossip.depa: %2$s has moved on for good. I'll miss them at the well — but I hope it's a fine place they're going.
%2$s left the village. A shame for us, but good for them, I think. I wished them well properly.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.confused/1: Sorry — you lost me there. Say it once more?
witty.dialogue.chatmode.confused/2: Hm, that one went past me. Try me again.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.hint/1: Ask me about %2$s — I'd enjoy that one.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.hint/2: %2$s, if you like. Any of them, honestly.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.shrug/1: No idea, and I'm quite cheerful about it.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.shrug/2: Couldn't tell you! Someone will know.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.dropped/1: Lost the thread there. Start me over?
witty.dialogue.chatmode.dropped/2: That's gone from me, sorry. What was it?
witty.dialogue.chatmode.busy/1: Hands full this second — give me a moment and I'm yours.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.muted/1: Right, I'll leave you to it. Wave when you want me.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.muted/2: Quiet from me. No hard feelings at all.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.farewell/1: Off you go, %1$s. Make it a good one!
witty.dialogue.chatmode.farewell/2: See you soon — and thanks for stopping.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.insult/1: Well, that's a shame. I'd rather we were kind.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.insult/2: Hm. I'll pretend I didn't catch that one.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.hail/2: Morning, %1$s — good to have you by.
witty.dialogue.chatmode.hail/3: Ah, you're here. That's the day improved.
witty.dialogue.conversations.day.rough.e: It is. And you resisted 'could be worse', which shows unusual restraint and excellent instincts.
witty.dialogue.conversations.checkin.rou: The wood, then. Tuesday. Bring the good axe and a low opinion of my stacking.
witty.dialogue.conversations.work.follow: ...It is. Everyone asks after the work. You asked after the labourer. Bold structural choice.
You'll stand with me. Now I've a witness, which is either support or terrible tactics on your part.
witty.dialogue.conversations.hopes.respo: You waited. A rare and underrated skill. Right — the hope, before I lose my nerve and make a joke.
witty.dialogue.conversations.life.revisi: You asked about my life once. I've since edited it considerably. This draft is better.
